title: GameFAQs: Does this game really have no option for classic bonus stars? — comperko, post 2

quotations.text: There are classic bonus stars but only 2 when playing less than 30 turns.
So if you turn on classic bonus stars there is coin and happening bonus stars.
If its 30 turns then theres also minigame bonus star.
